notes: Modified cash basis, school district. Governmental lines from the Total Governmental Funds column (pp7, 9). Page map: p1 net position (rpt 12), pp2-4 statement of activities, p5 governmental balance sheet (label column missing), pp6-9 governmental receipts/disbursements (fund columns pp6, 8; total column pp7, 9), p10 proprietary net position, p11 proprietary receipts/disbursements, pp12-19 fund budget schedules, p20 activities fund account schedule. Governmental roll-forward: 1,160,324 + 3,481,171 - 3,113,943 - 20,000 transfers out = 1,507,552 (ending cash). Transfers: total column shows in 0, out (20,000) after the Adjustments column eliminates 15,500 between General Fund (out 35,500) and Activities Fund (in 15,500); the 20,000 is the transfer to the School Nutrition (business-type) fund. Printed Other receipts 148,391 split using fund schedules: Activities Fund 140,536 (p18) + General Fund 6,040 (Textbook 20, Postsecondary 1,811, Refund of prior year 1,704, Miscellaneous 2,505, p12) + Special Building disposal of real property 1,815 (p17). Other Support Services 182,565 split by fund column: Depreciation 3,570 + Activities 178,995 (p8). Business-type (School Nutrition) from p11: operating receipts 33,692+452+143+23,691 = 57,978 plus interest 51 = 58,029 (total receipts not printed as one line, added); disbursements 93,447; 26,166 + 58,029 - 93,447 + 20,000 = 10,748. Balance sheet: p1 government-wide modified cash Total column (includes business-type); no liabilities. Detail: General Fund budget schedule used (function-only disbursements, so not itemized); General Fund Transfers 8000 (35,500) recorded as other financing -35,500 and the printed total disbursements and transfers 2,792,149 includes it; Unused Budget Authority line (budget only) skipped. Activities Fund recorded by account from p20 (supersedes the one-line activities budget schedule p18); zero-only accounts (C Club, Honor Society, One Act/Speech, Science Club) omitted; p20 interest 242 is included within the account receipts. Depreciation and Employee Benefit fund schedules print no total receipts/disbursements line so no detail_totals for them. School Nutrition printed Total Receipts 78,029 includes the 20,000 transfer.
